# Problem 14.10 - General Combined Loads {.unnumbered}

![Figure 1: A solid circular rod is subjected to a load and a moment.](images/521.png){fig-alt="A cantilevered solid circular rod is subjected to a point load F and a torsional force of F. The rod has a radius of r and a length of L."}

#| standalone: true

from shiny import App, render, ui, reactive
import random
import asyncio
import io
import math
import string
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

def generate_random_letters(length):
    # Generate a random string of letters of specified length
    return ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(length))  

problem_ID="521"
L=reactive.Value("__")
r=reactive.Value("__")
F=reactive.Value("__")
T=reactive.Value("__")
  
attempts=["Timestamp,Attempt,Answer,Feedback\n"]

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    #ui.markdown("**Please enter your ID number from your instructor and click to generate your problem**"),
    #ui.input_text("ID","", placeholder="Enter ID Number Here"),
    #ui.input_action_button("generate_problem", "Generate Problem", class_="btn-primary"),
    ui.markdown("**Problem Statement**"),
    ui.output_ui("ui_problem_statement"),
    ui.input_text("answer1","Your Answer for the normal stress in units of ksi", placeholder="Please enter your answer"),
    ui.input_text("answer2","Your Answer for the shear stress in units of ksi", placeholder="Please enter your answer"),
    ui.input_action_button("submit", "Check Answer", class_="btn-primary"),
)

def server(input, output, session):
    # Initialize a counter for attempts
    attempt_counter = reactive.Value(0)

    @output
    @render.ui
    def ui_problem_statement():
        randomize_vars()
        return[ui.markdown(f"A solid circular rod of length L = {L()} ft and radius r = {r()} in. is subjected to load F = {F()} kips and torsional moment T = {T()} kip-in. Determine the stress state at point A (report absolute values).")]
    
    #@reactive.Effect
    #@reactive.event(input.generate_problem)
    def randomize_vars():
        random.seed(101)
        L.set(random.randrange(10, 50, 1)/10)
        r.set(random.randrange(10, 30, 1)/10)
        F.set(random.randrange(10, 100, 1)/10)
        T.set(random.randrange(100, 300, 1))
        
    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.submit)
    def _():
        attempt_counter.set(attempt_counter() + 1)  # Increment the attempt counter on each submission.
        tau_xy = 2*T()/(math.pi*r()**3)
        sigma_x = F()*L()*48/(math.pi*r()**3)
        #instr= sigma_x/2+math.sqrt((sigma_x/2)**2+tau_xy**2)
		instr1 = sigma_x
		instr2 = tau_xy
        if math.isclose(float(input.answer1()), instr1, rel_tol=0.01):
            check1 = "*Correct*"
        else:
            check1 = "*Not Correct*"
			
        if math.isclose(float(input.answer2()), instr2, rel_tol=0.01):
            check2 = "*Correct*"
        else:
            check2 = "*Not Correct*"

        # Show feedback to the user.
        feedback = ui.markdown(f"Your answer for the normal stress of {input.answer1()} is {check1}. Your answer for the shear stress of {input.answer2()} is {check2}.")
        m = ui.modal(
            feedback,
            title="Feedback",
            easy_close=True
        )
        ui.modal_show(m)


# App installation
app = App(app_ui, server)
